overall_status: MATCH: all 19 fixed-order output records byte-match the locked oracle; the projection observes the complete incoming and outgoing BlockEdge state of every block before and after each valid half-delete, including peer identity, slot order, reverse_index, label, surviving reciprocal consistency, and PHI-slot identity mapping
architecture: locked synthetic BlockBasic control-flow graphs; no AddrSpace, instruction bytes, or PcodeOps are consumed by FlowBlock::halfDeleteInEdge/halfDeleteOutEdge
compiler_spec: not applicable: pure BlockEdge/FlowBlock state with no Funcdata prototype model

analysis_options.entrypoint: Direct private-state invocation of locked FlowBlock::halfDeleteInEdge and FlowBlock::halfDeleteOutEdge on BlockBasic objects connected through production BlockGraph::addEdge; Rust invokes the mapped BlockBasic methods on the same ordered graph shapes
analysis_options.prestate: Every case starts from a fresh graph with valid reciprocal half-edges created in a fixed order. Both halves receive the same distinct numeric label. No corrupted reverse index, invalid slot, empty-list deletion, or concurrent writer is introduced.
analysis_options.observation: One schema envelope followed by 18 case/phase records. Each record prints every block in creation order and every incoming/outgoing edge in slot order as peer:reverse_index:label, then reports reciprocal consistency for all surviving focus in/out edges and a slot-zipped PHI identity vector where applicable.
analysis_options.normalization: Block identity is normalized only from raw pointers/Arc addresses to creation-order names b0..bn. No edge, slot, order, reverse index, label, reciprocal failure, or PHI token is removed or reordered.
analysis_options.exception_policy: The locked bodies have no exception or validation branch. Their contract requires an existing slot; invalid or empty-list inputs can reach std::vector operator[]/pop_back undefined behavior and therefore have no defined oracle output to compare. The zero-slide valid boundary is covered with a single edge and with deletion of the last slot.

analysis_options.edge_constructor: BlockGraph::addEdge / BlockGraph::add_edge with fixed creation and insertion order
analysis_options.labels: distinct mirrored uint32 labels retained as raw decimal values
analysis_options.invocation: direct halfDeleteInEdge/halfDeleteOutEdge on a valid existing slot
analysis_options.observation: complete per-block in/out half-edge vectors plus focus reciprocal checks and PHI slot tokens
analysis_options.normalization: pointer identity to creation-order bN only

cases: in_nonlast_phi: four ordered predecessors, delete incoming slot 1, remove the matching test PHI token, observe two shifted surviving source halves
out_nonlast_ordered: four ordered successors, delete outgoing slot 1, observe two shifted surviving target halves
consecutive_in_phi: five predecessors, delete incoming slot 1 twice, observe the state after each call and the corresponding PHI token sequence
self_parallel_in: two self edges interleaved with two external predecessors, delete incoming slot 0 so a surviving self half and external halves shift
self_parallel_out: two self edges interleaved with two external successors, delete outgoing slot 0 so a surviving self half and external halves shift
bidirectional_ordered: parallel A-to-B and B-to-A edges interleaved with A-to-C/C-to-A, then one incoming and one outgoing middle deletion
single_out_slot: delete the only valid outgoing slot, covering zero loop iterations
last_in_slot: delete the last of two incoming slots, covering a valid last-slot zero-slide boundary

observation_schema.format: 19 fixed-order UTF-8 lines with a final newline: one envelope and 18 case/phase records
observation_schema.edge: peer creation-order name, reciprocal reverse_index, raw label for both in and out vectors
observation_schema.state: complete ordered edge vectors of every block; focus-side surviving reciprocal invariant; slot-zipped PHI identity tokens
observation_schema.mutation: before and after each call, plus both intermediate states for consecutive deletion and incoming/outgoing stages for the bidirectional case

build.cpp_oracle: The complete decompiler C++ subtree is exported from locked commit e40ed130 into a fresh temporary directory and libdecomp.a is rebuilt before linking the fixture; live oracle sources are identity- and dirty-state checked but never compiled as the comparand.
build.private_state_observer: #define private public is scoped to the fixture translation unit and exposes halfDeleteInEdge/halfDeleteOutEdge plus the two edge vectors without modifying the locked source.
build.rust_comparand: A tar snapshot of pinned Rugra base 8d917bf is materialized, only src/block.rs is overlaid, locked Ghidra is provided through the verified worktree symlink required by build.rs, and Cargo builds offline/locked with incremental compilation disabled under the global /tmp/rugra-cargo-build.lock and CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/rugra-target-block-halfdelete.
build.drift_check: All owned source, documentation, fixture, metadata, and runner files are hashed before and after execution.

coverage.incoming_nonlast_slide: MATCH: surviving local incoming entries retain source order/reverse_index/label while each source outgoing half decrements its reciprocal reverse index exactly once per left shift
coverage.outgoing_nonlast_slide: MATCH: surviving local outgoing entries retain target order/reverse_index/label while each target incoming half decrements its reciprocal reverse index exactly once per left shift
coverage.consecutive_delete: MATCH: two calls at the same incoming slot preserve the oracle's intermediate and final edge order and cumulative peer-index updates
coverage.phi_slot_to_in_edge: MATCH: after deleting the same slot from the test PHI identity vector, each remaining token stays zipped to the same predecessor as the shifted incoming edge order; this is the edge-order contract consumed by Funcdata::branchRemoveInternal
coverage.self_and_parallel_edges: MATCH: both incoming and outgoing cases exercise the held-self-lock path with two parallel self edges interleaved with external peers
coverage.bidirectional_order: MATCH: interleaved parallel A<->B and A<->C directions preserve their independent incoming/outgoing vector orders through middle-slot deletion
coverage.labels_and_removed_half: MATCH: every surviving label remains byte-identical and the deliberately retained removed counterpart is visible in the complete graph state, matching the half-delete contract
coverage.valid_zero_slide_boundaries: MATCH: single-edge and last-slot calls skip the slide loop and pop exactly one local entry
coverage.invalid_or_empty_slot: EXCLUDED AS UNDEFINED INPUT: the locked implementation has no exception/guard branch and can invoke std::vector undefined behavior; this is not a defined oracle behavior or a Rugra error-path contract
coverage.module_completion: NOT CLAIMED: block.rs remains L2 and other FlowBlock/BlockGraph algorithms retain separately tracked gaps
